title: rosa × hibernica var. armatissima
intro: Rosa × hibernica var. armatissima, commonly known as Irish briar or Irish rose, is a thorny, deciduous shrub that belongs to the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of Rosa × hibernica var. armatissima include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. However, further research is necessary to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents.
